page.overview:
What is Pinsir?

Pinsir resembles flat-stag beetle and has long, pricked horns on its head. Its whole body is a light brown color with three claws on each limb. It has small triangular angry white eyes with small black pupils and its mouth has multiple sharp teeth arranged horizontally rather than vertically. It has three white claws on the ends of each of its hands and feet. Its feet are thicker than its hands. As Mega Pinsir, it gains a large pair of clear, yellow wings with an area of orange venation near the base. Additionally, a set of brown elytra appear. Slicing through each side of the elytra is a pair of orange blades. Its arms are longer and it has a T-shaped spike on each forearm. The pincers on its head are now longer with larger spikes, its eyes are now yellow, and its pupils are now smaller. The claws on its feet also point straight outwards instead of to the side.

Pinsir is known for its strong pincers, using them aggressively in battle to either split foes into two or toss foes that are too tough to be crushed. Despite this nature, it grows weak in cold environments and will bury into dirt, sand, or leaves with their two pincers sticking up from the ground. It is also known to enjoy tree sap and Honey like many other -type Pokémon. Pinsir lives deep in the temperate forests and jungles, where it burrows underground or hides in the treetops on nights cold enough to render it immobile. It tends to group together as a result.

In the Alola region, it is known to get along well with Heracross while it has a strong rivalry with Vikavolt.

The size of their pincers are used to judge attractiveness; the bigger, the more attractive.
